goal: Ensure JSON-RPC batch error replies do not inherit the ID or version of preceding requests
Prevent batch error responses from being suppressed when following a notification
agreement: Concept support for adhering to JSON-RPC 2.0 specs and avoiding duplicate IDs in batches (pinheadmz)
Unaddressed suggestion to use a clearer invalid request string in the test (pinheadmz)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it fixes an edge case where invalid batch elements reuse previous request IDs
Avoids suppressing error replies when an invalid request follows a notification
Impact is limited to malformed non-object batch elements rather than standard requests
